bullets: Formulated Without: Gluten, GMOs, or Soy
Produced in a 3rd Party Audited cGMP Registered (Certified) Facility
paragraphs: California Gold Nutrition® Superfoods Blueberry Juice Powder makes it easy to add this superfood into your diet for an added boost of flavor and nutrients. Our Blueberry Juice Powder can be added to shakes, smoothies, yogurt, and oatmeal. You can even bake it into your favorite dishes for a dose of extra flavor. The naturally sweet and tart flavor of blueberries complements many other flavors, pairing well with strawberries, raspberries, banana, cinnamon, honey, and lemon.

blocks.label: Suggested use
paragraphs: Take one serving daily. Blend with shakes or smoothies. Sprinkle over yogurt or oatmeal. Bake in your favorite recipes.
Note: 2.5 grams per 1/2 tsp is an average. Individual scooping technique may yield less or more than 2.5 grams.
ONCE OPENED, BEST USED WITHIN 6 MONTHS.

paragraphs: Sealed for your protection. Do not use if pouch is punctured or seal is missing or broken. Store in a cool, dry place. Protect from heat, light, and moisture.

CONTAINS A FOOD-GRADE MOISTURE ABSORBER TO MAINTAIN FRESHNESS. DO NOT EAT.
